seo.title: Internationalization
seo.description: i18n system with typed keys, language validation, and strict localization patterns for multi-language applications

header.title: i18n System
header.description: Comprehensive guide to internationalization architecture. Includes automatic key typing, translation completeness checks, and dynamic resource loading.

benefit_text: Total type safety — the project will not compile if a key is missing or translation structures differ across languages.

infra_key.title: i18nKey Wrapper
infra_key.description: Identity function for typing string keys. Provides IDE autocompletion for a specific Namespace.

infra_types.title: Type Magic
infra_types.description: Recursive JSON object traversal via <one>TNestedKeyOf</one> to generate dot-notated key paths.

config_hub.title: Resource Registry
config_hub.description: In <one>i18n.config.ts</one>, import reference JSON via <two>import type</two> and build <three>TResources</three>. Vite: public/locales; Next: messages/ (recommended) or public/locales.

config_blocks.title: Translation Blocks
config_blocks.description: Configuring physical file locations and dynamic chunk loading in <one>i18n.blocks.ts</one>.

init_core.title: i18next Initialization
init_core.description: Binding plugins and configuration into a single library instance in <one>i18n.init.ts</one> (Vite SPA stack).

init_checker.title: Consistency Control
init_checker.description: Static check in <one>i18n.checker.ts</one>: satisfies catches missing keys, an explicit TNestedKeyOf check catches extra keys. Guarantees that all languages have an identical key structure.

usage.title: UI Usage (pick your stack)
usage.description: Same typed namespaces — different UI APIs and JSON roots. <one>Vite SPA</one> → <two>react-i18next</two> + <one>public/locales</one>. <three>Next.js App Router</three> → <four>next-intl</four> + <one>messages</one>.
usage.next_hint: Next.js App Router: <one>useTranslations</one> + t.rich. JSON: messages/[lng]/ (recommended) or public/locales/[lng]/ loaded via import() in request.ts.

switching.title: Language Switching
switching.description: Vite: <one>changeLanguage</one> + localStorage. Next.js: locale routing / next-intl navigation (not i18next.changeLanguage).

config.label: Configuration:
config.text: All settings are centralized in <one>shared/config/i18n</one>/. Each aspect (types, initialization, blocks) is separated into its own file.

locales.label: Translation Files:
locales.text: Vite: <one>public/locales/[lng]</one>/. Next.js: <two>messages/[lng]</two>/ (recommended) or public/locales/[lng]/. Nested folders group namespaces (e.g., <three>booking/order.json</three>).
